title: Choosing the apartment’s laundry cycle
titleZh: 公寓洗衣機的行程選擇
passage:
Laundry room notice | When to choose Extra Rinse

We often get questions about the Extra Rinse button on the shared washers. It adds a fresh-water rinse after the regular wash cycle. It does not add detergent or allow you to wash a larger load. For heavy items such as bath mats, follow the load limit printed inside the washer door.

The extra rinse can help when clothes still feel slippery after a wash. If you can see undissolved detergent on otherwise dry clothing, however, check the detergent drawer first. The liquid detergent compartment uses a sliding divider. Leave the divider up if you use powder. With the divider down, some powder may stay in the drawer until the final rinse, when it is too late to do another full wash.

If the machine stops and shows a water-supply warning, tell the building desk which machine you used. Do not run the same load a second time as a way to clear the warning.
passageZh:
洗衣間告示｜什麼時候選「額外漂洗」

常有人詢問共用洗衣機上的「額外漂洗」按鈕。它會在正常洗程後再用清水漂洗一次，不會增加洗劑，也不能因此多放衣物。清洗浴室地墊等厚重物品時，請遵守印在洗衣機門內側的衣物載量上限。

洗完的衣物摸起來還滑滑的，額外漂洗可能有幫助。但如果衣物已乾，還看得到未溶解的洗衣粉，請先檢查洗劑盒。液體洗劑槽有可滑動的隔板。使用洗衣粉時，把隔板留在上方。隔板往下時，有些洗衣粉可能一直留在盒內，到最後一次漂洗才沖出來，這時已來不及再做一次完整洗程。

如果機器停止並顯示供水警示，請告訴大樓服務櫃檯你使用了哪一台。不要為了清除警示就把同一批衣物再洗一次。
